content: {"praised":["First half is enjoyable, funny, charming road movie.","Melanie Griffith's zany, sexy performance adds humor and charisma.","Acting by Jeff Daniels, Ray Liotta, and Griffith is strong.","Story starts lighthearted, then explores deeper themes.","Criterion transfer enhances visual quality."],"criticized":["Plot shifts to sinister, losing initial charm.","Second half feels off-putting and less cohesive.","Tone changes abruptly, confusing genre expectations.","Some find it not a true comedy.","Ex-con husband subplot feels out of place."]}
